name: potsherd-claude-code-plugin
description: Marks dist/*.js as ES modules when this directory is installed on its own. A marketplace install copies only plugins/claude-code/, so the repository's root package.json is not found; Node then uses the nearest one above — on a real machine that is ~/.claude/package.json, which has no "type" field — and the bundle fails to load as CommonJS. A copy in /tmp has no package.json above it, so Node auto-detects ESM and the same bundle runs: that is why the fresh-copy test passed while the real install crashed.
